title: Ingo Swann affects a thermistor in a Faraday cage
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ingo Swann affects a thermistor in a Faraday cage, about early 1970s at California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they put a thermister inside of a fad cage and then inosan was able to affect that with his mind

related.note: The same early-1970s SRI test of Swann affecting a shielded device with Puthoff, but here the device is a thermistor in a Faraday cage rather than a shielded quark detector.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in early 1970s California, researchers Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ put a thermistor, a small sensor that reacts to temperature, inside a Faraday cage, a metal enclosure that blocks outside electrical signals. According to Michels, the psychic Ingo Swann was able to affect the sensor with his mind. If true, it would mean the mind can act on objects with no physical contact.
